import pandas as pd

# Load the datasets
time_series_df = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')

# Identify the relevant columns for Axes & Celts
axes_celts_time_series = time_series_df['AxesCelts']
axes_celts_inter_time_series = time_series_df['AxesCelts_inter']
axes_celts_capital = capital_df['ZBeil']

# Determine the peak values and their corresponding time periods
peak_axes_celts_time_series = axes_celts_time_series.idxmax()
peak_axes_celts_inter_time_series = axes_celts_inter_time_series.idxmax()
peak_axes_celts_capital = axes_celts_capital.idxmax()

peak_axes_celts_time_series, peak_axes_celts_inter_time_series, peak_axes_celts_capital

# Map the peak indices to the corresponding time periods
